summary: SK hynix Inc. filed a Form 6-K on August 19, 2026, reporting its board's decision to acquire 24,070,000 common shares (~3.3% of issued shares) for approximately KRW 40.0 trillion (based on KRW 1,662,000 closing price on August 18, 2026) via open-market purchases from August 20 to November 19, 2026. The treasury shares are intended for cancellation to improve shareholder value. SK Securities is the brokerage agent. The acquisition is limited by distributable profit under the Korean Commercial Act (KRW 91.6 trillion). This is a capital return program; watch execution pace and share price impact.
